description: Sync WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain, and workouts into Postgres and query them from any MCP client.
name: io.github.cunicopia-dev/whoop-postgres-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your WHOOP developer app (developer.whoop.com).
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Client secret of your WHOOP developer app.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth redirect URI, exactly as registered on the WHOOP app (e.g. http://localhost:8765/callback).
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_REDIRECT_URI

environmentVariables.description: Postgres DSN the server syncs into and reads from (e.g. postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/whoop). Tokens are stored in this database.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_DB_URL

title: WHOOP MCP
